scientific_question: Per requested Ugi generation attempt, how often does each method produce an exact-L1 whole-product graph whose local atom-bond and three-membered-ring chemistry occurs in the Ugi training fold?
nonclaims: Training-supported local chemistry is not synthesis success, stability, safety, activity or route closure.
Absence from local training support is an abstention under a bounded comparison policy, not proof of chemical impossibility.
The qualified yield supplements and never replaces raw exact-L1 yield.
This assessment performs no generation, route, proposal-engine or biological-oracle calls and selects no candidate.
